central_question: factorized index-derived BM25 tail probability as training-free RLT before a frozen reranker
harness_status: corrected-metrics-and-retrieval; historical results at results/historical/sha-11d27ef are obsolete

bm25.high_df_terms: never dropped on the reference path
bm25.dl_norm: precomputed at index build for (k1, b); other b values need a separate vector
bm25.postings: typed array('I') then NumPy (idx, X_t) with precomputed mu_t, var_t
bm25.retrieval: generation/touched accumulator; O(sum df_t), not O(N)

score_transforms.paper_exact: not computed: would require query-term multiplicities inside BM25
score_transforms.ceiling: (k1+1) * sum IDF of query terms with df_t > 0; OOV does not inflate the bound
score_transforms.I_gauss_diag: monotone map of z_diag via -log survival; not a validated P0

primary_endpoint: nDCG@10 after frozen MiniLM rerank of retained BM25 candidates

ir_metrics.ndcg: IDCG from full query qrels, independent of truncation/gating/reranker
ir_metrics.precision_at_k: hits_in_first_k / k even if fewer than k documents are returned
ir_metrics.map_denominator: number of qrel-positive documents for the query

calibration.judged_only_option: restrict AUROC/AP/Brier/ECE to explicitly judged documents when judged_mask is used
calibration.no_match_queries: kept; top-1 confidence is -inf; report no_match_rate

variance.var_diag: sum_t var_t from precomputed term moments
variance.var_joint: exact E[S^2]-E[S]^2 from touched BM25 scores (zeros for untouched docs)

surprise.null: GPD on the returned list, not the collection
surprise.selection: greedy Cramér–von Mises from both ends until no CvM improvement; no 8-step cap

not_reimplemented_reason: Meng et al. SIGIR 2024 already compared them to fixed-k on TREC DL; we treat fixed-k as the method to beat

cv.operating_point: inner CV: minimise mean candidates s.t. estimated mean ΔnDCG@10 >= -δ; outer test evaluates that fixed policy
cv.pareto_on_test: diagnostic only; not used to pick the reported point

bootstrap.unit: query-level OOF predictions concatenated across outer folds

reranker.cache_policy: score full BM25 top-100 once per dataset; reuse for all truncation policies
reranker.cache_contract: atomic tmp+fsync+rename; manifest must match dataset/query/candidate/model-revision/protocol/git SHA; missing CE score or empty text is a hard error

phase_b_eval.monotone_truncation: policies map to a BM25 prefix K_q; prefix metrics 0..K are precomputed after one CE pass

query_slice.policy: if n_judged_queries > 400, sample 400 qids with seed 20260915 after sorting; otherwise keep all
query_slice.label: results on a capped query set are not the official full-query BEIR split

skipped_datasets_reason: MS MARCO passage dump not local this round; large BEIR sets are kept with full corpus + query cap
historical_results: results/historical/sha-11d27ef — obsolete after harness correction; do not interpret
